question: Under an exactly matched branch-sealed training protocol, do the extra MLP-visible ACIL feature channels outperform fixed restricted-channel controls and ordinary linear interpolation?

falsifiable_claim.claim: The additional observation-only channels exposed to the shared ACIL MLP contribute a repeatable structured-mask improvement that cannot be explained by parameter count alone; this experiment does not claim that the controls remove every indirect geometric quantity from the interpolation formula.

shared: bit-identical parameter initialization within each dataset and seed
same fit windows, K3/K2 objective, masks, data order, optimizer and 20-epoch budget
same source-dev checkpoint selection and tune targets
exact_method_difference.value_only: Only B_linear, observed value, observation mask and local volatility; all remaining feature channels are exactly zero.
exact_method_difference.no_anchor: All registered features except explicit left/right anchor values, anchor delta and anchor slope; removed channels are exactly zero.
exact_method_difference.only_difference: fixed feature-channel masking before the shared MLP

oracle_policy.reason: This is a direct matched representation ablation with no selector; the three tiny models are the cheapest discriminating experiment.

training.objective: equal mean of K3 missing-target and K2 middle-anchor-drop normalized MAE
training.checkpoint: lowest source-dev ratio-of-sums NMAE pooled over all three masks; ties choose earlier epoch

metrics.primary: ratio-of-sums NMAE on immutable missing targets
metrics.dataset_aggregation: compute each dataset relative effect from pooled structured error/truth sums, then average the two dataset effects equally

uncertainty.prototype: paired circular-window block bootstrap within each dataset
uncertainty.extension: outer resample three seed bundles with replacement, then paired circular-window blocks
uncertainty.shared_draws: all methods and mask families share seed/window selections

stop_rules.prototype_failure: kill the ACIL feature-attribution claim; do not run bundles 2 or 3 and do not change feature masks or gates
stop_rules.prototype_success: run only the frozen bundles 2 and 3 extension
stop_rules.extension_failure: retain ACIL only as an empirical interpolation baseline; do not claim anchor/gap feature attribution
stop_rules.extension_success: allow a separately frozen final confirmation or downstream transfer experiment

execution.infrastructure_retry: same job identity, command, seed and hashes only
